method.monitor: Return to the same 1–3 accessible plants or patches and check open flowers yes/no/uncertain every 2–3 days as spring accelerates.
method.onset: The onset can only be placed after the last reviewed 'no' and on or before the first reviewed 'yes'.
method.bound: A tightly bounded interval needs at least two 'no' visits and a last-no to first-yes gap of at most four days.
method.microclimate: One spot soil temperature is context only. Calibration requires all 122 daily measured soil means March–June from the same depth and monitored plot.
method.validation: A site's anchor plot A must contribute 8 qualifying paired seasons, 3 rolling historic holdouts, and soil-model interval-distance error below calendar baseline.
method.privacy: Public output contains only named preserves and anonymized plot A/B/C identifiers. No precise plant coordinates, visitors, or free-text proof.
method.warning: No monitored or calibrated site-level bloom predictions are inferred from regional air-temperature forecasts or nearby photographs.
